category_title: Students with intellectual disabilities who exhibit disruptive behaviors (hitting, making sounds, damaging property)
student_description: This student is frequently unresponsive to verbal instructions and exhibits physical aggression or property destruction when seated near peers. They require a highly structured approach utilizing visual rewards, deliberate wait time, non-verbal behavioral corrections, and proactive peer education to foster a supportive environment.

criteria.rationale: Because the student's aggressive behaviors can alienate peers, long-term success requires cultivating an understanding and protective peer group.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan includes educating the rest of the class about the student's unique needs and modeling how to interact with them (e.g., conducting a discussion when the student is absent).
